judge.shardDecision: Three members, 1,125 lines, and a code surface that reaches the schema, packages/validation, the guard stack, the holidays module and the reports service — more than one pass should hold while also walking forty requirements against three tables. I dispatched one spec-reviewer child per member (the slice's split), each carrying its files, the text of its criteria quoted, what to enumerate and a path to write to; none read the register. I held the sixteen criteria the slice marks as needing the whole bundle — the contradiction family, scope, the obligations that can only be answered across members, divergence and S-58 — and read all three members in full myself for them, plus specs/time-off/README.md and specs/organization/03-holidays.md. I opened every file a shard's claim or dismissal rested on: packages/validation/src/roles.ts, packages/validation/src/reports.ts, packages/validation/src/holiday-messages.ts, packages/validation/src/holidays.ts, apps/api/src/auth/capability.guard.ts, apps/api/src/auth/require-capability.decorator.ts, apps/api/src/holidays/holidays.controller.ts, apps/api/src/holidays/holidays.service.ts, apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma. Two of the four blockers came back from a shard; two are mine. Worth a person's attention outside the findings: shard 2 established that apps/web/src/ds.ts does not exist in this repository — @ds surfaces from packages/ds/src/index.ts as @devscribed/ds — so S-06's own text names a path that is gone. That is a defect of the register, not of this spec, and no finding may name a path outside the spec, so it is recorded here instead.

judge.shardDecision: Read myself, no shards dispatched. The slice offered one shard per member, but this is a delta pass over 283 changed lines in a 1,246-line bundle, and the change is one rule replacing another everywhere it was stated: the country chain went from three links (MemberProfile.country, Account.phoneCountryCode, Organization.countryCode) to two stated ones (Membership.countryCode, Organization.countryCode), and the organization-country write went from admin-only-403 to admin-and-manager-404. Every defect I found is a place the old rule survived in a member the new rule was written in — an acceptance criterion in the main spec against a requirement in the same file, an E2E case in the cases member against a requirement in the main spec and a testid row in the contracts member, a Verification Plan row against a case two hundred lines below it. A shard holding one member cannot see any of them, and the lead would then be re-reading all three members anyway to answer the sixteen whole-bundle criteria. Splitting would have bought parallelism and paid for it in exactly the findings that matter. I read all three members in full, plus specs/time-off/README.md (which the bundle delegates blast radius to under S-48) and the three area READMEs the range touched, and I opened every file a claim rests on.

request: A vacation calendar based on holidays and vacation requests, viewable for the whole organization, for several teams, or for specific people, drawn as a horizontal timeline where each row is a member and each column is a day. Holidays follow a country a manager states on the member, falling back to a country stated on the organization; the phone country code is not a source.
